# Xilinx/AMD documents (not in git)

The PDFs are copyrighted and not redistributable, so `reference/vendor/*` is git-ignored except for this file. Put
local copies here. Download from docs.amd.com; the plain-PDF API used on 2026-10-26 is
`https://docs.amd.com/api/khub/documents/<id>/content`.
